description: Fix stale Recent Sessions on re-navigation by adding window focus listener to re-read localStorage
steps: 1. In src/features/question-bank/components/recent-sessions.tsx, add a useEffect that registers a 'focus' event listener on the window. On focus, re-read sessions from localStorage using getSessions(), filter/sort/slice, and call setSessions() with the updated list.
2. Clean up the event listener in the useEffect cleanup function.
3. Verify build and lint pass: npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint
acceptance_criteria: RecentSessions component refreshes its session list when the window regains focus
The useState lazy initializer is preserved for initial load
npx tsc --noEmit passes with zero errors
npm run lint passes with zero errors
